result.title: FlexReader: Towards Adaptive Decoding Paths for Efficient Arbitrary-Length Scene Text Recognition
result.summary: Existing Scene Text Recognition (STR) models are inherently coupled with a specific decoding strategy by their training paradigms, limiting their flexibility in deployment across diverse recognition scenarios. In this paper, we propose FlexReader, an STR model that supports multiple decoding strides, enabling a single model to achieve an optimal accuracy-efficiency trade-off across different datasets. Specifically, we first introduce a Sub-string Perception module to perceive the target sub-string from visual features, followed by multiple parallel decoding blocks that independently decode each character in the sub-string. During inference, FlexReader supports decoding with arbitrary strides within the perceived sub-string range. Furthermore, we propose Adaptive Prefix Decoding, which adaptively selects the decoding stride at each step based on the model's confidence in the decoded characters, thereby identifying the optimal decoding path for each input. Experimental results demonstrate that FlexReader exhibits robust recognition capability across a diverse range of benchmarks, including those featuring long text, curved text, and occlusions. It consistently outperforms existing decoding strategies in recognition accuracy while achieving up to 6-flod decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding.

AI.brief_summary: FlexReader 提出一种支持多种解码步长的场景文本识别模型：先用子串感知模块从视觉特征中定位目标子串，再由多个并行解码块独立解码其中每个字符，并在推理时用基于字符置信度的自适应前缀解码为每个输入选择解码步长，以在准确率与速度间取得折中。
AI.relevance_reason: 其置信度驱动的解码步长自适应选择与「动态计算、停止决策」问题有形式上的对应，可供核查能否迁移为 LVR 中按证据充分性调整推理长度或提前停止的机制；但任务是 OCR 字符识别，不涉及多模态推理状态，联系较远。
